name: Trinion changelog
description: Records a change log of all changes made when saving nodes.
project_description:
This module is multilingual. There are 2 languages available in it - Russian and English. The description of the module in Russian is available at the link .

 Functions 
 What is the basic functionality? 

This module solves the problem of fixing the saving of all changes to the Node in Drupal. Since in Drupal you can change a field in Node or delete it, and if you have not saved the Node revision, then you will not see these changes.

The functionality of saving revisions may not display some of the changes made, and this module will help you see the full log of Node changes.

 What unique features does this project add? 

The ability to log Node changes and present them in a ready-made form (in the form of a report).

 When and why would someone use this module? 

If 2 or more people are working on the site content and there is a need to control content changes, then this module will help you with this.

For example, changes in statuses, comments, priorities and other parameters can be saved in the Taskbook module thanks to the Trinion Change log module. Directly in the task, in the log, it will be described in detail which user and when made this or that change to any of the fields of the Task.

 What use cases are there? 

You can use it as just a separate module to control changes in the site content.

The module can be used in conjunction with other Trinion modules to monitor changes.

 After installation 
 How does this module work after it is installed? 

After installation, the user has a link to go to Views, where you can view all the changes.

 Should I go to the configuration page? 

Yes, on the configuration page in the Trinion Change log menu, you need to select which types of content the module needs to track and log on them.

 Is it worth looking for new types of materials? 

Yes, new types of content are emerging:

 
 Change 
 Change Line 
 
 Additional requirements 
 Does this project need something besides the Drupal core? 

No.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Are there any projects extending or improving the functionality of this project? 

No.
